skills.description: Dina Gilio-Whitaker's Who Gets to Be Indian? — an executable toolkit exploring the complex landscape of Native American identity: ethnic fraud, tribal enrollment and disenrollment, cultural appropriation, and what it means to be Indian in contemporary America.
